references.text: Describes the original organization of Dan's camp as the rear guard, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai as leader. This forms the basis for the marching order described in chapter 10.
Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai is mentioned here first as the representative of the tribe of Dan in the census.
Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai brought his offering as leader of the tribe of Dan at the dedication of the altar.
Describes the role of those who gather the stragglers in the rear guard, a function similar to what Dan had during the wilderness journey.
Shows the use of vanguard and rearguard in Israel's military organization, reflecting the practice from the wilderness journey.
The Lord shall be their rear guard (מְאַסֵּף), the same Hebrew word used for Dan's role in Numbers 10:25.
